title: Table locality: GLOBAL, REGIONAL BY TABLE, REGIONAL BY ROW

steps.title: Create a three-region database + US and EU super regions
steps.narration: Register us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Super region US is {us-east, us-west}; EU is {eu-west}. That is what later strips cross-ocean replicas.
sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS app;
ALTER DATABASE app SET PRIMARY REGION "us-east";
ALTER DATABASE app ADD REGION IF NOT EXISTS "us-west";
ALTER DATABASE app ADD REGION IF NOT EXISTS "eu-west";
ALTER DATABASE app SURVIVE ZONE FAILURE;
SET enable_super_regions = 'on';
ALTER ROLE ALL SET enable_super_regions = on;
ALTER DATABASE app ADD SUPER REGION "US" VALUES "us-east", "us-west";
ALTER DATABASE app ADD SUPER REGION "EU" VALUES "eu-west";
SHOW SUPER REGIONS FROM DATABASE app;

steps.title: Create prices, orders, and customers as GLOBAL
steps.narration: All three tables start GLOBAL: replicas sit in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Twelve ranges each for a dense before picture.
sql: USE app;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prices (sku INT PRIMARY KEY, amount DECIMAL, currency STRING);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, sku INT, qty INT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name STRING, country STRING);
INSERT INTO prices SELECT i, (i % 50) + 1, CASE WHEN i % 2 = 0 THEN 'USD' ELSE 'EUR' END FROM generate_series(1, 1200) AS g(i) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO orders SELECT i, (i % 1200) + 1, (i % 5) + 1 FROM generate_series(1, 1200) AS g(i) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO customers SELECT i, 'customer-' || i, CASE i % 6 WHEN 0 THEN 'CA' WHEN 1 THEN 'TX' WHEN 2 THEN 'NY' WHEN 3 THEN 'IE' WHEN 4 THEN 'SE' ELSE 'DE' END FROM generate_series(1, 1200) AS g(i) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
ALTER TABLE prices SET (schema_locked = false);
ALTER TABLE orders SET (schema_locked = false);
ALTER TABLE customers SET (schema_locked = false);
ALTER TABLE prices SET LOCALITY GLOBAL;
ALTER TABLE orders SET LOCALITY GLOBAL;
ALTER TABLE customers SET LOCALITY GLOBAL;

steps.title: Before — all three tables in all three regions
steps.narration: GLOBAL before picture. orders, customers, and prices each have replicas in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
sql: WITH raw AS (SELECT 'orders' AS tbl, range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.orders WITH DETAILS] UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.customers WITH DETAILS] UNION ALL SELECT 'prices', range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.prices WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.tbl, r.range_id, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'zone=', 2), ',', 1) AS zone FROM raw r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT r.tbl, r.range_id, ARRAY(SELECT p.zone FROM pairs p WHERE p.tbl = r.tbl AND p.range_id = r.range_id) AS replicas FROM raw r ORDER BY r.tbl, r.range_id;

WITH raw AS (SELECT 'orders' AS tbl, range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.orders WITH DETAILS] UNION ALL SELECT 'customers', range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.customers WITH DETAILS] UNION ALL SELECT 'prices', range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.prices WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.tbl, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'zone=', 2), ',', 1) AS zone FROM raw r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT tbl, zone, count(*) AS replicas FROM pairs GROUP BY tbl, zone ORDER BY tbl, zone;

steps.title: Before RBT — orders replicas in US-East, US-West, and EU
steps.narration: orders is still GLOBAL. Replicas should list us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Next step confines the whole table to EU.
sql: WITH ranges AS (SELECT range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.orders WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.range_id, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'zone=', 2), ',', 1) AS zone FROM ranges r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT r.range_id, ARRAY(SELECT p.zone FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id) AS replicas FROM ranges r ORDER BY r.range_id;

WITH ranges AS (SELECT range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.orders WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'zone=', 2), ',', 1) AS zone FROM ranges r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT zone, count(*) AS replicas FROM pairs GROUP BY zone ORDER BY zone;

steps.title: Regional by table — confine orders to EU
steps.narration: Home the whole table in eu-west. Super region EU drops every us-east and us-west replica — not only voters.
sql: SET enable_super_regions = 'on';
ALTER TABLE app.orders SET (schema_locked = false);
ALTER TABLE app.orders SET LOCALITY REGIONAL BY TABLE IN "eu-west";

steps.title: After RBT — orders replicas in EU only
steps.narration: orders should show eu-west only. us-east and us-west should be empty for this table.
sql: WITH ranges AS (SELECT range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.orders WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.range_id, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'zone=', 2), ',', 1) AS zone FROM ranges r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT r.range_id, ARRAY(SELECT p.zone FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id) AS replicas FROM ranges r ORDER BY r.range_id;

steps.title: Before RBR — customers still in all three regions
steps.narration: customers is still GLOBAL. Pinning orders did not move this table. Replicas remain in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

steps.title: Regional by row — home West, East, and EU rows in their regions
steps.narration: CA → us-west. TX/NY → us-east. IE/SE/DE → eu-west. Each row’s replicas stay inside its super region.
sql: SET enable_super_regions = 'on';
SET sql_safe_updates = false;
ALTER TABLE app.customers SET (schema_locked = false);
ALTER TABLE app.customers SET LOCALITY REGIONAL BY ROW;

UPDATE app.customers SET crdb_region = CASE country WHEN 'CA' THEN 'us-west' WHEN 'TX' THEN 'us-east' WHEN 'NY' THEN 'us-east' WHEN 'IE' THEN 'eu-west' WHEN 'SE' THEN 'eu-west' WHEN 'DE' THEN 'eu-west' END;
SET sql_safe_updates = true;

steps.title: After RBR — customers split by home region
steps.narration: West-homed ranges: us-west only. East-homed ranges: us-east only. EU-homed ranges: eu-west only.
sql: WITH ranges AS (SELECT range_id, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.customers WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.range_id, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'zone=', 2), ',', 1) AS zone FROM ranges r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT r.range_id, ARRAY(SELECT p.zone FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id) AS replicas FROM ranges r ORDER BY r.range_id;
